name: Estimated glomerular filtration rate
rangeNote: KDIGO groups: 90 or more is normal; 60–89 is mildly reduced (often normal with age); below 60 for 3 months or more is chronic kidney disease. Many labs report values above 60 or 90 simply as ">60" or ">90".
summary: eGFR estimates how much blood your kidneys filter each minute. Labs calculate it from creatinine (and sometimes cystatin C), age and sex.

high.meaning: A high eGFR is generally fine. Very high values can happen with low muscle mass, because the estimate is based on creatinine.

low.meaning: A lower eGFR means the kidneys are filtering less. A single low value can be temporary; doctors look for values that stay low over 3 months.
commonCauses: High muscle mass or creatine supplements (falsely low)

sources.title: KDIGO 2024 Clinical Practice Guideline for the Evaluation and Management of Chronic Kidney Disease
New Creatinine- and Cystatin C-Based Equations to Estimate GFR without Race
